saw_lines: Most buyers of sensitivity tests have spent months guessing and buy only when a dog or child’s symptom finally wins.
So the sale is won or lost in line one, when a worried owner decides this kit is worth the price.
Your site shows 500,000 customers and 567 reviews, yet 0 of 13 ads carry a proof number. Put 567 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Nov 2026
points: 0 of 13 ads carry a proof number, while your site shows 500,000 customers and 567 reviews. Buyers have little reason to trust the kit. Put 567 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
The offer appears after 89% of the copy in a median ad of 133 words, so most viewers never reach it. Open every ad with free shipping on USA orders of $50+, an offer none of your 13 ads use yet.

3 of 13 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, and buyers who expect a friend’s story read them as sales pitches. Whitelist those three from the creator account, then cut three variations of the creator’s own story.

Your median ad runs 133 words and the longest 229, so the first line must stop the scroll before the offer shows. Cut every ad to two lines and the offer, then test three short versions against the current copy.
